title: Vector and dual Walsh characters
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every vector $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, the dual Walsh character associated with the linear functional corresponding to $\gamma$ under the standard dot-product identification of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with its dual equals the vector Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$.
